```{r setup}
#PACKAGES
packages <- c("seqTools", "sessioninfo")
purrr::walk(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
rm(packages)

#DATA
data(testingCounts)
```

#cpm
After QC and removal of bad cells/samples, normalize RNA samples/cells to the 
total counts per million accounting for differences in sequencing depth.
```{r, fig.align="center", fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
#setup test data
rownames(testingCounts) <- testingCounts[[1]]
testingCounts[[1]] <- NULL
counts <- testingCounts[2:12, ]

cpm(counts)
```

#log2(cpm+1)
log2 transforms scRNAseq counts data in preperation for ...
```{r}
cpm.log2(counts)
```

#rescale.features
Rescales each gene (row) to the interval [0, 1]. Useful for heatmap plotting,
for example.
```{r}
rescale.features(counts)
```

#pearsons.dist
Typically used upstream of tSNE when tSNE can accept a distance matrix.
```{r}
pearsons.dist(counts, 1:11)
```
